facts.statement: The genus Bolivosteus was described by Goujet, Janvier, and Suarez-Riglos in 1986.
Fossils of Bolivosteus date to the Eifelian stage.
Bolivosteus chacomensis is a rhenanid placoderm found in the Eifelian of Bolivia.
facts.quote: Bolivosteus chacomensis is a rhenanid placoderm from the Eifelian of Bolivia

facts.statement: The Malvinokaffric faunas, where Bolivosteus was found, represent cold-water ecosystems near or at the South Pole during the Middle Devonian.
facts.quote: The Malvinokaffric faunas represent a series of cold-water ecosystems near or at the South Pole during the Middle Devonian

facts.statement: Bolivosteus is classified as a genus.
Bolivosteus belongs to the order Rhenanida.
Bolivosteus is a member of the class Placodermi.
Bolivosteus is assigned to the family Asterosteidae.
The only known species in the genus is B. chacomensis.
Bolivosteus chacomensis is a rhenanid placoderm from the Eifelian of Bolivia.
facts.quote: Bolivosteus chacomensis es un placodermo renánido del Eifeliense de Bolivia

facts.statement: The Malvinokaffric faunas represent a series of cold-water ecosystems near or at the South Pole during the Middle Devonian.
facts.quote: Las faunas Malvinokaffric representan una serie de ecosistemas de aguas frías cerca o en el Polo Sur durante el Devónico Medio

facts.statement: B. chacomensis is known from skull fragments and scales.
facts.quote: B. chacomensis se conoce a partir de fragmentos de cráneo y escamas

facts.statement: The parent group of the genus Bolivosteus is Rhenanida.
The class of the genus Bolivosteus is Placodermi.
